lines: In an American wedding, some close friends of the wedding couple stand at the front of the room.
The friends of the bride are bridesmaids and the friends of the groom are groomsmen.
Long ago, bridesmaids and groomsmen dressed just as formally as the bride and groom.
They wanted to trick evil spirits.
By doing this, the evil spirits would not be able to distinguish the real wedding couple from the bridesmaids and groomsmen.
The groomsmen also protected the bride.
Nowadays, groomsmen have a special party for the groom before the wedding.
At the wedding, the bridesmaids all wear dresses in the same color.
One of the bridesmaids and one of the groomsmen sign their names as witnesses of the wedding.

Long ago, bridesmaids and groomsmen dressed just as formally as the bride and groom. They wanted to trick evil spirits. By doing this, the evil spirits would not be able to distinguish the real wedding couple from the bridesmaids and groomsmen. The groomsmen also protected the bride. Nowadays, groomsmen have a special party for the groom before the wedding. At the wedding, the bridesmaids all wear dresses in the same color. One of the bridesmaids and one of the groomsmen sign their names as witnesses of the wedding.
